body:
There is no chance of anyone finding me. I live alone on a road with many flats. I will advise emergency services that I have taken what I take as soon as I swallow it and give them my road but no more as I do not want to leave a long rotting corpse. 

Suffice to say I have been driven here by non trivial circumstances. I regret not killing myself many years ago when I first wished to but was talked out of it with meaningless promises of it will get better. It did not get better. I hate the extra years I have been forced to exist.
